title: Branch-Level Energy Localization in Three-Phase Loads: Code and Data of the Test Cases
description: MATLAB code, waveforms, balance residuals and figures of the test cases of the manuscript Branch-Level Energy Localization in Three-Phase Loads: Resolving Indeterminacy in Time-Domain, by F. G. Montoya, F. de Leon, F. M. Arrabal-Campos and A. Alcayde, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Delivery.
